The words good cooks use 👩‍🍳

Read the text, then flip every card to learn the new words. Read each word out loud and try the example sentence.

Read the text
Cooking for beginners
Anyone can learn to make their favourite dishes. Why don't you take our online cooking course and see? These photos show you some cooking basics — how to chop, peel, mix, fry, boil, roast and bake real food. Make sure there's an adult in the house when you use the oven, or boil or fry food. 🔥
2
What can you learn on the online course?
You can learn cooking basics — how to make (cook) your favourite dishes.

03 Practice · use the words ≈ 35 min

Now you try 🧑‍🍳

Use the new words in real recipes. Choose your answers, then press Check answers. Green means correct!

3
Complete the photo labels with the cooking verbs Look at each photo and choose the correct verb. Photo 1 is done for you.
Answer key · 1 chop · 2 beat · 3 peel · 4 slice · 5 mix · 6 roast · 7 boil · 8 fry · 9 bake · 10 add
4
Which dish is each activity for? Match each activity to a dish. One activity is not needed for any of them.
Answer key · Roasted vegetables = chop the onions & garlic, slice the vegetables, roast the vegetables · Chips = peel the potatoes, fry the potatoes in hot oil, add some salt · Chocolate cake = beat the eggs, mix the cocoa with the eggs & butter, bake the cake · Not needed: boil the pasta.
5
Count the objects in the kitchen Look at the picture and write how many of each object you can see. Count carefully — the objects are hidden among other kitchen things.
Move the magnifying glass over the picture and count the objects you can see
Answer key · bowl = 4 · cake tin = 5 · frying pan = 2 · oven = 1 · pot = 3

7
Listen and choose the correct answer Press play to hear Tom talk about his dessert. Listen twice, then answer. You can also read the text.

🎧 Tom's easy dessert

Listen to Tom. What is he making, and how?
Hi! I'm Tom, and today I'm making an easy dessert with bananas. First, I peel three bananas and slice them. Then I put the banana slices in a bowl — not a pot and not a cake tin, just a nice big bowl. Next, I make a sweet sauce. I use orange juice and a little sugar, but I don't use any butter, because I want it to be light and healthy. Finally, I put the bowl in the oven and bake the dessert for ten minutes. Mmm, warm bananas — perfect!
Answer key · 1 b (bananas) · 2 a (in a bowl) · 3 b (butter) · 4 b (baking the dessert)
